rows.question: What is the total number of singers?
Show the name and the release year of the song by the youngest singer.
rows.gold_sql: SELECT song_name ,  song_release_year FROM singer ORDER BY age LIMIT 1
rows.raw: SELECT s.Song_Name, s.Song_release_year FROM singer s WHERE s.Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM singer)
rows.pred_sql: SELECT s.Song_Name, s.Song_release_year FROM singer s WHERE s.Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM singer)

rows.question: What are all the song names by singers who are older than average?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age  >  (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)
rows.raw: SELECT s.Song_Name FROM singer s WHERE s.Age > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM singer)
rows.pred_sql: SELECT s.Song_Name FROM singer s WHERE s.Age > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM singer)

rows.question: What is the maximum capacity and the average of all stadiums ?
What is the name and capacity for the stadium with highest average attendance?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1
rows.raw: SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium);
rows.pred_sql: SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium)

rows.question: Which year has most number of concerts?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR FROM concert GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
rows.raw: SELECT Year, COUNT(*) as concert_count FROM concert GROUP BY Year ORDER BY concert_count DESC LIMIT 1;
